 'Avatar: Seven Havens' finale: Pavi goes on the run in this exclusive clip
 Pavi reunites with an old friend in the "Avatar: Seven Havens" finale.

 It's Avatar: Seven Havens finale eve, and what better way to get ready than by checking out a sneak peek of what's to come?
 SEE ALSO: 
 'Avatar: Seven Havens' finally shows us how Korra broke the world 
 In an exclusive clip from episode 10, titled "Ghosts and Spirits," viewers get to witness the fallout from Seven Havens ' penultimate batch of episodes, in which Nisha (voiced by Aishu Devan) revealed herself to be the Avatar. Instead of being welcomed, the citizens of Ellora turned on her, and she fled into the Harshlands with her cat monkey Ruhi.
 While Nisha has left Ellora, her twin sister and fellow Avatar Pavi (voiced by Saheli Khan) is still in the Haven. She has to keep a lower profile than ever, as wanted posters for Nisha have gone up all around the city. Security in Ellora has grown even harsher since Nisha's departure, with new checkpoints popping up around the city. Over loudspeaker, Chancellor Kayoko (voiced by Jennifer Sun Bell) urges citizens to stay indoors and report any suspicious activity, further proof of the fear and paranoia that now dominate Ellora.
 Amidst this foreboding crackdown, Pavi still somehow manages to find hope. She reunites with crystal beetle Sang, whom she rescued at the very beginning of Avatar: Seven Havens . With a familiar face by her side, maybe she'll be able to seek out Nisha and learn the answers about their parents once and for all.
